comment: Base UI docs bake pin. scripts/fetch-baseui.mjs reads this to fetch the llms.txt agent docs from base-ui.com (public pages robots.txt permits; /api/ is never requested) and the MIT licence from the pinned mui/base-ui ref, whose sha256 is recorded in provenance.json. Base UI is headless, so this layer is docs-only: cross-links to the ReUI gallery cover the visuals. Bump license.ref here and re-run npm run baseui to refresh the layer.
